gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-saira: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric pushes its wide letters apart with real attitude. Saira follows with a plain sans manner, rounded and clean, which makes the whole thing feel like a sprinter in a tidy jacket.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sarpanch: Wide, fast and a bit cocky. Sarpanch brings a compact, approachable sans-serif voice with a wide-mouthed e, and that friendliness against Ethnocentric's swagger is the pair's best trick.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-savate: Contemporary and tidy, Savate does the quiet work. Ethnocentric's low-contrast, widely spaced capitals hit hard, while this sans flows beneath with gently modulated strokes and open curves that keep a long passage smooth.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-schibsted-gro: Approachable first, then fast: Schibsted Grotesk sits low. Ethnocentric is built to hit hard with wide, aggressive letters, whereas the sans below it is built to be read, with tall open bowls and terminals that stay unclosed.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sen: Modern through and through, Sen is the steady one. Ethnocentric's spaced-out capitals carry the speed while Sen's tall lowercase and uniform line draw the eye along without any thick-and-thin fuss.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sintony: Sintony reads clean and contemporary, with a chunky, tall midzone and curves that never clog. Ethnocentric can go big above it.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans looks modern and professional, with tall rounded lowercase like cut acrylic pieces and no swelling strokes anywhere. Ethnocentric, fast and spread wide, feels like the loud sibling next to Sofia Sans, which stays measured.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sofia-sans-se: Ethnocentric brings fast, aggressive capitals with short ascenders over big bowls. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed then runs like drawn wire, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-sono: Sono is tall in the lowercase and generously spaced, with each a left slightly ajar. Ethnocentric is the one that sprints, wide and aggressive, and Sono's approachable sans-serif manner is the one that lets you settle in.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-stack-sans-he: Loud, wide and speedy up top, with Ethnocentric's short ascenders over big bowls leading the charge. Stack Sans Headline sits beneath, monoline and approachable, with a deep middle band.
